title: Mucheri weGoridhe Murenje
intro: Fungidzira musasa mukuru wegwenga munguva yekumirira uye kusava nechokwadi. Mutungamiriri mukuru aenda kumusangano naMwari, achisiya nharaunda ichida chimwe chinhu chinobatika chekubata. Mukumbomira ikoko kusina kugadzikana, munhu anonyengetedza anofamba mberi ane zvipikirwa zvinopenya uye chisikwa chakangwara chinoita sechipenyu.
clues: Ndakanga ndiri mumwe weavo vakabva kuIjipiti naMusa, tichiona gungwa richiparadzaniswa kuti titize.
Ndakatarisa apo mutungamiri wedu akaenda kugomo kwehusiku makumi mana kuti awane gwara.
Ndakaunganidza zvishongo kubva kuvanhu ndikazviumba nemaoko angu.
Ndakagadzira mhuru yairira, uye ndakashevedza vanhu kuti vauye kwairi.
Ndakatora guruva shoma kubva munzira yemutumwa ndikarikandira mune zvandaigadzira.
Ndakatarisana naMusa ndikanzi nditi 'musandibate' togara takaparadzana, ndichivimbisana kuti tichatongwa.

arabic: قَالَ فَٱذْهَبْ فَإِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ أَن تَقُولَ لَا مِسَاسَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَكَ مَوْعِدًۭا لَّن تُخْلَفَهُۥ ۖ وَٱنظُرْ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِكَ ٱلَّذِى ظَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ عَاكِفًۭا ۖ لَّنُحَرِّقَنَّهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَنسِفَنَّهُۥ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ نَسْفًا
verse: [Moses] said, "Then go. And indeed, it is [decreed] for you in [this] life to say, 'No contact.' And indeed, you have an appointment [in the Hereafter] you will not fail to keep. And look at your 'god' to which you remained devoted. We will surely burn it and blow it [i.e., its ashes] into the sea with a blast. (20:97)
